method: Public category/product HTML, structured data, saved local harvest evidence, and documented platform behavior. Null means the endpoint was not proven and must be captured in the browser network log before an override is added.

rows.productCount: 746 filter total; 100 rendered per page at observation
rows.paginationType: AJAX numeric pagination without dependable URL history
rows.paginationControl: Buttons 1, 2, 3, 4; wait for product-grid mutation after click
rows.backgroundEndpoint: GraphQL searchProducts request; capture the exact operation URL and variables from the browser session
rows.productCardBoundary: one repeated product tile containing category, title, price, stock and Sepete Ekle
rows.titleSource: product-tile anchor; Product.name on detail page wins
rows.brandSource: detail structured data, then title lexicon
rows.colourSource: colour filter/title suffix or selected detail variant
rows.priceSource: selected variant customer price; reject installment and crossed-out list price
rows.stockSource: selected variant availability plus buy control
rows.variantUrlBehavior: query option such as ?Renk=Gri; emit each sellable option as a child SKU
rows.preorderBehavior: only Preorder/Ön Sipariş plus an enabled buy control is preorder
knownTraps: category includes vacuum storage bags and other accessories
page number may live only in JavaScript state
100 visible products is not the category total
variant stock differs by colour/packaging
rows.sampleEvidence: Category exposed 100 Ürün, stock filters Stokta 452 / Stokta Yok 294, numeric page buttons, Sepete Ekle, and a Vakumlu Filament Saklama Poşeti accessory.

rows.productCount: 144 discovered in saved local harvest evidence
rows.priceSource: TRY product-detail sale price after client rendering
rows.variantUrlBehavior: inspect Ticimax option IDs; emit separate child only where selection changes the sellable SKU
rows.preorderBehavior: Ön Sipariş with enabled cart is sellable preorder
knownTraps: client-side currency conversion
category card price can be stale
category includes dryers and engineering accessories
overlay image is not the product image
rows.sampleEvidence: Saved run discovered 144 category products over numeric pages; request context must stay TRY.

rows.productCount: not asserted; enumerate until T-Soft response is empty
rows.paginationType: numeric page plus T-Soft service calls
rows.variantUrlBehavior: enumerate service/variation identifiers when options alter stock or price
rows.preorderBehavior: enabled cart plus Ön Sipariş is preorder
knownTraps: grid may show KDV Hariç
installment amounts resemble prices
service pagination can outlive visible URL
rows.sampleEvidence: Observed category pagination uses sayfa; customer price must come from detail evidence including VAT, not the grid net amount.

rows.productCount: category pagination observed; exact count must be read each run
rows.stockSource: detail availability plus enabled buy control
rows.variantUrlBehavior: inspect option values and issue variant requests when price/stock changes
rows.preorderBehavior: enabled cart plus preorder label only
knownTraps: USD + KDV base price can coexist with converted TRY checkout price
installment amount is not product price
IdeaSoft footer identifies platform but is not product evidence
rows.sampleEvidence: A detail page displayed 9.00 USD + KDV, 53.24 TL installment, and 499.17 TL payable price; only the payable price is valid.

rows.paginationType: WordPress pagination and Woo variation AJAX
rows.backgroundEndpoint: /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products when enabled; variation forms otherwise embed variation JSON or call Woo AJAX
rows.colourSource: variation attribute (commonly pa_color/pa_colour) validated by lexicon
rows.stockSource: selected variation is_in_stock/is_purchasable and buy control
rows.variantUrlBehavior: one parent URL may expose many variation_id combinations; emit each sellable combination
rows.preorderBehavior: Woo backorder/preorder state is sellable only with purchasable variation
knownTraps: parent price range is not a child price
parent stock does not prove variation stock
gallery images can include every colour
rows.sampleEvidence: Creality Hyper PLA page exposes white and black as separately available WooCommerce variations.

rows.productCount: dynamic; follow category pagination until no new product_id
rows.priceSource: gross customer price, never Ex Tax
rows.stockSource: product option availability and enabled cart
rows.variantUrlBehavior: options often post under option[id]; emit combinations that change SKU/stock
rows.preorderBehavior: enabled cart plus explicit preorder/backorder state
knownTraps: gross and Ex Tax values coexist
route URLs repeat category parameters
option-level stock can differ
rows.sampleEvidence: Category uses OpenCart route/path URLs and renders both gross and Ex Tax amounts.

rows.productCount: dynamic collection count; enumerate collection pagination/product JSON
rows.backgroundEndpoint: /products/{handle}.js or product JSON embedded by the theme
rows.colourSource: selected variant option validated by colour lexicon
rows.stockSource: selected variant available and enabled cart
rows.variantUrlBehavior: variant query ID is child SKU identity; enumerate all variants
rows.preorderBehavior: available variant plus explicit preorder label
knownTraps: campaign, installment and FAST/EFT amounts coexist
RAL codes are colour metadata, not variants
family page contains many colour swatches
rows.sampleEvidence: Porima PLA uses ?variant=49130120184155; cards show list, campaign, installment and FAST prices, while colours include Beyaz RAL9003.

rows.backgroundEndpoint: /products/{handle}.js or product JSON embedded by the theme
rows.packagingSource: Type option: Refill or Filament with spool
rows.stockSource: selected variant availability/Sold out and buy control
rows.variantUrlBehavior: colour and Type combinations are separate child SKUs
rows.preorderBehavior: explicit preorder with enabled purchase only
knownTraps: one product handle covers refill and spool
sold-out state differs per option
marketing product line is a material variant axis
rows.sampleEvidence: PETG HF exposes colour, Type (Refill / Filament with spool), 1 kg, 1.75 mm and option-specific sold-out state.
